note: The Guard and Reserve zip and the recreation benefits zip are not in this project or workspace. Their contents were recovered from earlier VetBuddy conversations where the files were read into seed builders and the demo. Recovered data is a lead (tier 4) or a project record (tier 0); none of it is VERIFIED, and every imported row keeps a pointer back to this manifest.
